Jyggalag/Sithis/Kynareth/Mara are STAT-only; Mehrunes Dagon is worldspace-placement only. A shrine-prayer adapter would require PDV to place its own invisible marker ACTIs/trigger volumes at shrine cell positions (new ESP + placement + runtime) OR a location-trigger hook (new PDV_FLST_HolySites + manager handler) - both ESP/runtime design decisions, held for review. No clean data-only adapter exists.
Local readback is not runtime/manual proof or Authoria maintainer acceptance.
